title: Complex variance
statement: Given a complex Fourier system on finite sets $\Omega$ and $\iota$, and a function $f:\Omega\to\mathbb{C}$, define its variance as the covariance of $f$ with itself.
hypotheses_covered: A complex Fourier system on $\Omega$ and $\iota$
